summary: Both prior findings are resolved. The plan preserves the explicit Electron/macOS/Windows/app-owned-sidecar decision while treating current PRD/UX amendments as review-required research context, cites ADR-0002, and requires distinct import, create, app-list removal/archive, and physical disk/worktree deletion coverage in both the vendor matrix and repository audit. The scoped latest research request is covered.

resolved_findings.resolution: Plan Decisions and assumptions and contract DR-1 distinguish preserved approved feature scope, the explicit Electron runtime decision, and current PRD/UX v0.6 amendments whose exact hashes are not implementation-approved. Both cite docs/decisions/0002-desktop-runtime.md, consistent with PRD/UX headers and spec-index v0.12.

Plan AC-1 and AC-3 and matching contract acceptance explicitly enumerate import, create, remove from app list/archive, and physical disk/worktree delete as distinct behaviors in both comparative coverage and the actual Electron repository audit.

review_notes: The requested four product families and capability groups are covered: workspace/project/worktree lifecycle; right-side browser/terminal/file/diff/artifact surfaces; live tool-state, approval, question, progress, result and cancel/recovery interactions; and skills/MCP/plugins/agents/tools inventory and configuration.

First-party citations, fact/inference/documentation-gap separation, file/symbol evidence, a Korean durable report with access date, coherent baseline recommendations and ordered next slices with risks and dependencies provide suitable research deliverables.

The registered section/link-presence check is structural only. Coordinator citation verification and the frozen-report independent analysis review remain necessary for evidence entailment and substantive coverage. This pass does not establish vendor behavior, runtime correctness or implementation approval.
review_boundary: Focused independent plan review of the assigned latest research scope. Read current plan and contract, prior plan-r2 report, scoped PRD/UX/spec-index/ADR requirements and run binding metadata. No product-source edits, vendor research, application audit, runtime tests, research report authorship or ledger edits.
